issue_id_format.pilot_run_id_description: Unique identifier of the pilot run, assigned by the pilot operator.

pilot-blocker.definition: Issue blocks pilot continuation. Must be resolved or accepted before the pilot continues.

high.definition: Issue affects a significant portion of the pilot scope.

medium.definition: Issue affects a small portion of the pilot scope or has a clear workaround.

category_taxonomy.bug: A defect in the model, the routes, the services, or the persistence layer.
category_taxonomy.unexpected-behavior: The model produces output that is outside the documented range, but the cause is not yet known.
category_taxonomy.ux: A user-experience issue that does not affect model correctness.
category_taxonomy.infra: An environment, deployment, or observability issue.
category_taxonomy.scope: A scope misalignment (e.g. the pilot user attempts a generic-solar or generic-wind input set).

sensitivity_taxonomy.public: No redaction required. May be shared in any context.
sensitivity_taxonomy.internal: Internal use only. May be shared within the project team. Not for external use.
sensitivity_taxonomy.confidential: Sensitive. May be shared with the project lead, the pilot operator, and the B-track owner. Not for reviewer-facing or external use.
sensitivity_taxonomy.restricted: Highly sensitive. May be shared with the project lead only. Includes any pilot user data, any production data references, any NDA-protected data, any security incident details.

owner_placeholders.project_lead: Overall responsibility for the gate / pilot.
owner_placeholders.b_track_owner: Responsibility for the B-track artifacts (B3, B7, B9, B11, B12, B13, B15-B19).
owner_placeholders.legal_placeholder: Responsibility for legal review (placeholder; actual review by appropriate party).
owner_placeholders.security_placeholder: Responsibility for security review (placeholder; actual review by appropriate party).
owner_placeholders.agent_a_coordination: For issues that are Agent A code, the B-track coordinates with Agent A. The B-track never modifies Agent A files.

no_go_claim_impact_options.none: The issue does not change the no-go claim list. Common case.
no_go_claim_impact_options.new_claim_category: A new claim category is identified. Requires a B11 commercial messaging guardrail update.
no_go_claim_impact_options.existing_claim_strengthened: An existing no-go claim is strengthened. Requires a B11 update.
no_go_claim_impact_options.existing_claim_weakened: An existing no-go claim is weakened. Requires a dedicated governance change. Rare.
no_go_claim_impact_options.requires_dedicated_governance_change: The issue requires a dedicated governance change. Reserved for issues that cross the no-go boundary.

b_track_artifact_update_flags.b3_matrix_update_required: Issue changes the B3 matrix current_status, evidence_category, missing_evidence, blockers, or notes for any area.
b_track_artifact_update_flags.b12_heatmap_update_required: Issue changes the B12 heatmap confidence_label for any area.
b_track_artifact_update_flags.b13_paid_pilot_gate_update_required: Issue changes the B13 gate status for any PG-XX gate.
b_track_artifact_update_flags.b15_b19_artifacts_update_required: Issue changes any B15-B19 governance artifact (B17, B18, B19, B19 demo script guardrail).
b_track_artifact_update_flags.b14_refresh_tracker_update_required: Issue is a new Agent A phase that requires a B-track governance refresh.

global_notes: This template is empty at package creation. It is populated only when a controlled pilot has actually run. Do not claim a pilot has happened unless actual pilot results are later provided. Do not invent pilot results. Do not pre-populate the template with hypothetical results.
Pilot issue logs are internal evidence. They are not external validation, not a customer reference, and not a substitute for any B-track governance artifact.

Claude review is separate. The Phase 51N checkpoint includes a Claude review preparation pack on the Agent A side; Claude review itself is handled outside this branch and is not represented in B20 as completed.
The paid pilot gate (B13) is a separate stage. B20 is for the controlled internal pilot, not the paid pilot. B20 does not authorize the paid pilot.

The no-go claim list is governed by B1 (no_go_claims.md). The B11 commercial messaging guardrail is the commercial-side enforcement. B20 records no-go_claim_impact per issue; a 'none' impact is the common case.
